title: harness-config team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/harness-config.yaml, the team layer of the harness-config plugin's settings. The suppressions mapping is read by plugins/harness-config/skills/audit/scripts/audit-engine.sh and by /harness-config:audit-pass; only this layer enacts a suppression. Entry keys follow the finding-suppression convention: docs/conventions/finding-suppression/README.md.

site.description: One site the finding is about: its surface and its anchor under each algorithm version. Quote the anchor/v1 key; the plugin's YAML reader takes a plain key only of letters, digits, _ and -.

surface.description: The surface, as the audit names it (a repo-relative path, or a scope label such as user:settings.json).

^anchor/v[1-9][0-9]*$.description: The site's anchor under that algorithm version.

entry.description: A deliberately kept finding. The constituents are authoritative: an entry whose check, claim and sites do not hash to its key is reported malformed and does not suppress.

check.description: The plugin-qualified check that raised the finding.

claim.description: The canonical claim id plus bound parameters.

sites.description: Every site the finding is about.

date.description: When it was accepted, as YYYY-MM-DD.

suppressions.description: Deliberately kept findings of /harness-config:audit and /harness-config:audit-pass, keyed by finding_id.
